create_tool_component: create a ToolComponent dataclass instance with name, version, and organization fields
build_sarif_tool_component: build a SARIF ToolComponent representing an analysis tool driver with semanticVersion and informationUri
create_tool_component_rules: create a ToolComponent with a list of ReportingDescriptor rules and notifications
test_tool_component_fields: test the ToolComponent dataclass with all optional fields set to None except required name and language
summarize_tool_component: summarize the ToolComponent dataclass fields used to describe a SARIF analysis tool component
